title: Customer Support Specialist
tools_required: excel; customer service; customer support; admin
why_it_fits: Customer Support match. 4 skills: excel, customer service, customer support, admin. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
Our client is a premier Australian importer and distributor of high-quality nursery and baby products. They deliver premium prams, travel systems, and accessories to consumers and retail partners across Australia via their e-commerce store, independent stockists, and industry expos. As a fast-moving, family-owned business, they are dedicated to operational excellence, clear communication, and outstanding customer care.

They are now seeking to hire a Customer Support Specialist to deliver responsive, end-to-end support for consumers and retail partners across multiple communication channels. This role plays a vital part in driving high customer satisfaction, resolving order and warranty enquiries efficiently, and ensuring seamless operations between internal teams, warehouses, and stockists.

Job ResponsibilitiesCustomer Support & Enquiries
- Provide warm, responsive customer and retailer support across phone, email, live chat, and messaging channels
- Answer product, order, delivery, warranty, and troubleshooting enquiries with accuracy and care
- Handle complex or sensitive customer situations with patience, discretion, and empathy
- Request customer feedback and reviews at appropriate touchpoints to support service excellence

Order & Inventory Operations
- Track customer orders and backorders proactively to provide accurate stock availability updates and ETAs
- Record all interactions thoroughly in the helpdesk platform to ensure complete case histories
- Manage case resolution actively to minimise overdue or unassigned customer tickets

Stakeholder Coordination
- Liaise with local operations, warehouse staff, and freight providers to resolve shipping and delivery issues
- Provide dedicated support and issue resolution for independent retail stockists

Process & Quality Improvement
- Maintain internal knowledge bases, FAQs, response templates, and procedure notes
- Identify recurring product or service issues and suggest practical workflow improvements
- Utilise approved AI tools to assist in drafting non-sensitive customer communications and documentation
- Minimum 2 years of experience in customer service, e-commerce support, or order management
- Outstanding written and verbal English skills with a clear, professional tone
- Demonstrated experience managing both inbound and outbound customer support calls
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities independently
- Sound commercial judgement when handling warranties, returns, and sensitive information

Nice-to-Have Skills
- Previous experience supporting Australian customers by phone
- Background in retail, consumer goods, nursery products, or logistics support
- Experience using helpdesk, e-commerce, or order management platforms such as Dixa, Shopify, or Cin7
- Practical experience using AI tools to draft communications and streamline administrative tasks
- Permanent work-from-home set-up
- Dayshift (Australian Eastern Standard Time business hours)
- Full-time job
- HMO (STAFF only)
- Annual leave
- 13-month pay
- With Government mandated benefits
